title: Knowledge run and Cited Trends: safe and fast daily or on demand
description: Weekly is too slow while iterating. Three changes: (1) trend-drafts freshness accepts a daily or manual run (snapshot asOf = start date, within TREND_DRAFTS_MAX_AGE_DAYS, or the Monday the snapshot stage writes), plus configurable trend windows in days (default 28); (2) operator IAM read of story_draft Proposals (id, title, summary, targets, state, createdAt) so ideas trends dedupes under IAM, plus an anchor-entity cooldown (default 7 days); (3) incremental, idempotent monitor-record import (content-hash ledger in the run state bucket, parallel writes), target: minutes with no new records. Shipped's schedule is not changed here.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed in develop: #724 (trend-drafts freshness: start date, max age 1 day or the Monday the snapshot stage stamps; trend window in days, default 28), #728 (operator listStoryDrafts read: id, title, summary, targets, state, createdAt; anchor cooldown default 7 days), #727 (incremental monitor-record import: content-hash ledger in corpus state, parallel reads and writes, request counts 11,458 -> 654 per pass on a Shipped-sized fixture). No release, no deploy, Shipped schedule unchanged. Deploy order: backend (listStoryDrafts) before the image; set trendWindowDays, trendCooldownDays, KNOWLEDGE_MONITOR_FULL only if wanted.
